profile.headline: Computer Science & Statistics @ Berkeley
profile.summary:
Hi! Quick snippet about me: I am a lifelong learner who loves to leverage math and technology to solve complex and ambiguous problems with others and impact the way we see the world around us.

Please feel free to reach out! 🤗

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Worked on an interactive simulation tool enabling researchers to visualize and compute thermal physiology responses in ventilated building environments.

company.name: UC Berkeley, Rausser College of Natural Resources

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Built an application to plan drone-based seeding paths for post-wildfire reforestation. Integrated backend algorithms into an interface for visualizing optimized flight paths.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: URAP - Developed Python-based simulation software for electrical simulations and data visualizations to support researchers.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Developed political context narratives using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to integrate real-world data and insights into story and policy analysis.

company.name: UC Berkeley College of Computing, Data Science, and Society
